items.summary: Add a backend function that allows a bootstrapped super-admin principal (hardcoded or set on first call when no admin exists) to grant the admin role to a given principal. On canister initialization, automatically assign the admin role to the deployer's principal so the first user can self-promote.

Add an admin self-promotion UI flow: when a logged-in Internet Identity user visits the Admin page and is not yet an admin, display a 'Claim Admin Access' button that calls the backend to grant them admin privileges (only succeeds if no admin exists yet or they are already an admin). After a successful claim, refresh the admin status and grant access to the AdminPanel.
